## Type of change
- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] refactor (no behavioral change)
- [ ] perf
- [ ] security
- [ ] docs / chore / build / ci

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added / updated (unit, integration, or E2E)
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] DB schema changes include a Prisma migration
- [ ] No secrets or PII in code, tests, or fixtures
- [ ] Audit log entries added for any new state-changing endpoints
- [ ] RBAC enforced on new authenticated endpoints (`@RequireRoles(...)`)
- [ ] Updated CHANGELOG / docs if user-facing
